items.title: Rudy Mazzari Interview, 1959-11-06
items.q: Well, I always wound up playing jobs, you know, in the same band and several times

ctx.x: Were you with him pretty steady?

Well, I always wound up playing jobs, you know, in the same band and several times, well, you know, Fazz, he was, he was so popular that people would just beg him, I said, please come down to my joint and play even if it's only, all right.

a couple of tunes or something, you know. And he would. I mean, he'd try to go to all these places, but if he tried to go to all of them, there wouldn't be enough time in the day. So he tried to make the few ones that he could, and he asked me if I would care to go along with him, you know. And I said, sure. So I learned a lot by going after him, and I learned how popular he was and how well he played, and I got to know a lot of things about him that I didn't know. And he really was.
